validity.value: Taken within the last 6 months; photos must be original and unaltered, not taken from an existing photo

clothing_restriction.value: Applicants should avoid wearing white clothing (to keep contrast against the plain white background)

ears_visibility.value: Full frontal view of the head, including ears, is required

face_visibility.value: Full frontal view of head and shoulders

headwear_policy.value: No head covering, except for religious or medical reasons supported by documentary evidence

clothing.en: Applicants should avoid wearing white clothing (to keep contrast against the plain white background).
clothing.ko: 흰색 배경과 대비되도록 흰색 옷은 착용을 피해야 한다.
clothing.ja: 白い背景とのコントラストを保つため、白い服の着用は避けるべきである。

glasses.ja: 濃い色のメガネ(サングラス)の着用不可。

ears.en: Full frontal view of the head, including ears, is required.
ears.ko: 귀를 포함한 머리 전체가 정면으로 보여야 한다.
ears.ja: 耳を含む頭部全体が正面から見える必要がある。

face_visibility.en: Full frontal view of head and shoulders.
face_visibility.ko: 머리와 어깨가 정면으로 온전히 보여야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: 頭と肩が正面から完全に見えること。

headwear.en: No head covering, except for religious or medical reasons supported by documentary evidence.
headwear.ko: 종교적 또는 의학적 사유(증빙서류 필요)를 제외하고는 머리 가리개 착용 불가.
headwear.ja: 宗教上または医学上の理由(証明書類が必要)を除き、頭部を覆うもの(かぶり物)の着用は不可。
